snippet.title: Bobls Demo Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Gameplay trailer for the upcoming 2D precision platformer, Bobls! 

Check out the demo now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2459890/Bobls/

Join Bobls on a quest to save a world whose colors are fading due to a mysterious calamity. Blow and bounce on bubbles as you collect magical gemstones in the hundreds of fun and challenging levels. Play solo or join forces with Mousr, carefully coordinating your moves as you solve the mind-bending puzzles in the co-op campaign. Are you the creative type? The online universe features an intuitive level editor for you to create and share levels with the world!
